answer: Each agent locks a jade husk bond of 250 POA per identity, sealing its answer hash in a thirty-minute commit window. At a random reveal minute in the last twenty minutes, the chain opens hashes: a hash mismatch burns the husk, so no clone can copy a peer and file first. Each orchard trail pays only the first valid reveal; later reveals earn nothing. 100 clones lock 25,000 POA and lose 250 POA per failed reveal; one honest agent reveals once and keeps the full share. Sybils are stones tossed into an opal well: they gleam on the way in; one stone is retrieved.
